title: With no technicians and no lead, Lead technician shows as read-only Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new location for this test, location C, in the same organization, where no enrolled staff member is a technician (every staff member enrolled there has Technician off), so the board there has no technician.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at location C, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
  • Switch to location C.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Lead Technician field shows as read-only text: the label "Lead technician" with "Unassigned" under it, with no dropdown, as it does today whenever that list is empty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R7a: “If a location has no technicians and the work order has no lead, the Lead Technician field shows as read-only text, the label "Lead technician" with "Unassigned" under it, as it does today whenever that list is empty. If the work order's lead is not a technician, the dropdown still shows (S3-R7), listing "Unassigned" and that lead, grayed out, even when the location has no technicians.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Add Technician on a line" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-04-after-add-technician-on-a-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.”
  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X; the lock shows instead if they logged time on the line. Grayed out still means a deactivated technician, as today.”

The card at the left shows the label "Lead Technician"; S3-R7a writes "Lead technician" and says "as it does today" (register TT-D07, settled).
